name: Stain Interstage — Trim (EA_SIDE)
intent: Between-coat interstage for stain/sealer/clear apply on EA_SIDE substrates (int_door_slab / DSST). Uses door-side keepers shared with paint-side MOD_INTERSTAGE_DOOR.
doctrine: EA_SIDE parallel to LF/SF interstage. Shares the same four door-side keepers (inspect / sand / patch / clean) used by the paint-side MOD_INTERSTAGE_DOOR — door interstage work is identical whether the door is being painted or stained; only the material modifier differs (handled in apply, not here).
